# Introduction {.unnumbered}

## Organizing Principles

1. The structure of the book loosely parallels ***project sequence*** rather than fundamental concepts.  
  + Follows example assessment creation project (discussed on 2/7/26 -- creativity or ennui thrown out as 1^st^ construct considerations)

2. Content is linked to corresponding Standards

3. Forks to psychometric orientations where appropriate:

+ Item Response Theory
+ Rasch modeling
+ Classical Test Theory
+ Network psychometrics

4. Applications are interactive

There is no dedicated chapter on the history of testing or important theoretical moments. Instead, we reference historical contributors throughout our presentation. For an enjoyable and informative presentation of important historical markers, we recommend @guion2011assessment's chapter on "Basic Concepts in Measurement".
